_readme: Copy this to content.json in your own template copy and fill it in.
Every key is optional: a missing key falls back to the approved V7 value, so
an empty manifest renders the approved reel unchanged.
Run `node apply-content.mjs` after editing — it inlines the manifest into the
design page. `npm run render:template` does that for you.
Scene DURATIONS are not here: they live in window.OM_SCENES in the design page.
Changing them changes the frame count and invalidates the baseline.

copy.hook_1: Scene 1, first line, over the hook photograph.
copy.hook_2: Scene 1, second line, over the interior photograph.
copy.ai_search: Scene 2 headline. One trailing word is set in gold.
copy.ai_search_accent: the trailing word, exactly as it appears in ai_search
copy.search_query: The natural-language query typed into the search field.
copy.analysis:
Scene 4 headline, line one.
Line two.
copy.market:
Scene 6 headline, line one.
Line two.

_readme: Paths are relative to the template's project/ directory.
Add new imagery under a NEW filename; never overwrite an approved asset.
listing_stack is the real shape of the results scene: three cards stacked
BEHIND the main card, deepest first. The listing_peek_left / listing_peek_right
spellings are accepted as aliases for the first two, for schema compatibility.

_staging_pair_rule: staging_before and staging_after must be the SAME room from the SAME camera:
identical geometry, window proportions, camera angle, ceiling height and door
openings. The slider reveals one over the other; any mismatch reads as a cheat.
